$comment: ARIA Email Draft card — v1.5 (Teams desktop and mobile).
Usage
This is a reference template, not a deployed artefact. The Teams bot populates
the `{{...}}` placeholders at runtime from the EmailDraft object returned by
POST /api/chat before sending the card to the Teams channel.
Placeholders
{{draft.subject}}            string  — email subject line
{{draft.body}}               string  — full email body (plain text, \n line breaks)
{{draft.suggestedRecipient}} string  — e.g. 'your HR Business Partner'
{{draft.tone}}               string  — one of: professional | empathetic | factual
{{draft.policySourceUrls}}   array   — canonical SharePoint URLs cited in the body
{{draft.*json*}}             string  — full EmailDraft serialised as JSON (for Action.Submit data)
Mobile behaviour
Teams renders Adaptive Cards in a single-column layout on mobile automatically.
The ColumnSet used for the policy links uses 'stretch' so it collapses gracefully.
The Regenerate Input.Text and submit button stack naturally on small screens.
Clipboard / copy-out
Teams Desktop: the bot handles the 'copy' Action.Submit and uses the
Microsoft Bot Framework Activity 'copyToClipboard' invoke to write to the clipboard.
Teams Mobile: fall back to showing the full body in a highlighted TextBlock that the
user can long-press to copy. This is handled by the bot, not by this card template.

body.$comment: Policy sources — omit this Container entirely when policySourceUrls is empty.

items.$comment: Repeat one Action.OpenUrl per URL in draft.policySourceUrls at bot render time.
